title: Lady Mira and the Golden Bell
moral: Do not give up, even small efforts lead to success.

scenes.summary: Lady Mira learns that the golden bell is missing and begins her journey.
scenes.text: Lady Mira lived in a bright castle and was known for being kind and brave. One day, the golden bell stopped ringing. She promised the king and queen that she would find it and set out on her journey with her pony Pepper.
scenes.image_prompt: kind knight girl in castle holding helmet with pony beside her colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Lady Mira searches but cannot easily find the bell.
scenes.text: Lady Mira went to the village and asked people about the bell. A baker told her he heard a sound near the bridge, so she went there to investigate.
scenes.image_prompt: knight asking villagers near bakery small town cartoon children style

scenes.summary: She finds the bell stuck under the bridge but struggles to reach it.
scenes.text: At the bridge, Lady Mira saw the bell stuck under wooden boards. She tried to lift the board carefully but it was difficult.
scenes.image_prompt: knight girl lifting wooden plank under bridge finding golden bell cartoon style

scenes.summary: With patience, she successfully retrieves the bell.
scenes.text: Lady Mira kept trying and finally lifted the board enough to reach the bell and free it carefully.
scenes.image_prompt: knight girl holding golden bell smiling success colorful kids illustration

scenes.summary: Lady Mira returns the bell and restores happiness in the castle.
scenes.text: Lady Mira brought the bell back to the castle. It rang again, and everyone celebrated her bravery and kindness.
scenes.image_prompt: castle celebration knight ringing bell people happy colorful cartoon style

story: Lady Mira lived in a bright castle and was known for being kind and brave. One day, the golden bell stopped ringing. She promised the king and queen that she would find it and set out on her journey with her pony Pepper. Lady Mira went to the village and asked people about the bell. A baker told her he heard a sound near the bridge, so she went there to investigate. At the bridge, Lady Mira saw the bell stuck under wooden boards. She tried to lift the board carefully but it was difficult. Lady Mira kept trying and finally lifted the board enough to reach the bell and free it carefully. Lady Mira brought the bell back to the castle. It rang again, and everyone celebrated her bravery and kindness.
